title: session-load measures the intake hook's real cost at session start, its drift scan running item checks
goal: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --intake-real replays arm A's SessionStart intake hook in a replay clone left as the checkout is (no pin of the item files), so its drift scan runs item checks up to its wall-clock budget as in a session in the main checkout, and writes for it the rows cpu_s, wall_s and spawns with case 'idle hook intake real', its cpu_s note naming the scan budget; the pinned arm comparison stays as it is; and kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv holds a 5-rep record of it

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'A', '--intake-real', '--reps', '1', '--out', out],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load --intake-real exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
val = {(r['case'], r['arm'], r['metric']): (float(r['value']), r['note']) for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load'}
for m in ('cpu_s', 'wall_s', 'spawns'):
    assert ('idle hook intake real', 'A', m) in val, ('no unpinned intake row', m)
assert val[('idle hook intake real', 'A', 'spawns')][0] > val.get(('idle hook intake', 'A', 'spawns'), (0, ''))[0], 'the unpinned intake run starts no more processes than the pinned one'
assert 'budget' in val[('idle hook intake real', 'A', 'cpu_s')][1], 'the unpinned cpu_s note names no scan budget'

notes: Premise from ST-7nuaruwn's first record (before g8's pin): the SessionStart intake hook's drift scan took about 50 s and 50 CPU seconds per session start in a replay clone, against under 15 starts for every other hook; the pinned record leaves it out (gate g8 of ST-7nuaruwn). The hook files nothing in a linked worktree under .claude/worktrees/ (kb/_self/backlog.md), so dispatched workers skip it; sessions in the main checkout, interactive or headless, pay it. Its figure goes into the switch decision of ST-qqpcgqe7. Operator chose on 2026-10-26: keep the pin and measure this apart.
